title: Recovering jobs from the dead-letter queue after CVX-4301

posts.author: on_call_omar
posts.body: A downstream API was down for an hour and ~2000 jobs hit `CVX-4301` and went to the dead-letter queue. The API is back. How do I replay them, and can I stop this happening next time?

posts.author: nadia_corvex
posts.body:
Replay: `corvex dlq requeue --queue <name> --all` (needs the `dlq:manage` scope), or filter by class with `--class SyncOrder`. They go back on the original queue with their retry counter reset.

Prevention for known-flaky dependencies: raise `queue.max_retries` for that queue, switch `queue.retry_backoff` to `exponential` if it isn't already, and consider a circuit-breaker in the job so a dependency outage fails fast and reschedules with a longer delay instead of burning all 5 attempts in a minute. Failed jobs are kept for `retention.failed` (default 168h) so you have a week to replay.
